technique_name: Create the ending for this story
description: He turned around, and there was the woman he had been searching for all these months. She smiled at him and wordlessly held out her hand. He took it and they walked together into the setting sun, leaving the past behind them. From that day on, they never looked back.
example: The man was walking down the street, trying to decide whether to go left or right, when he suddenly heard a voice calling him.
